purpose: Crash-safe restart cursor after transport interruption.

reconciled_timeout_incident.rule: Never infer compute failure from message-delivery timeout when durable result/report/manifest already exist.

timeout_recovery_algorithm: Read CURRENT_STATE, then CURRENT_INFLIGHT, then this pointer.
Resume from the first missing durable phase; do not rerun completed work solely because message delivery failed.
Official compute requires committed producer bytes and exact Git-blob verification.
Persist result, report, workbook/Drive readback and manifest before advancing CURRENT_STATE.
Require DELTA rebuild artifact gate success.

execution_hardening.producer_atomic_output: NamedTemporaryFile + flush + fsync + os.replace where the producer writes a file
execution_hardening.large_stdout_policy: Persist detailed diagnostics to durable JSON; keep transport output compact.
execution_hardening.phase_checkpoint_policy: Advance CURRENT_INFLIGHT and recovery pointer immediately after each durable phase.
execution_hardening.cursor_close_sequence: Result/report + rebuild manifest + CURRENT_INFLIGHT + recovery pointer + CURRENT_STATE; require final CI.
